title: Phase I Study of Dasatinib (BMS-354825) and Capecitabine for Women With Advanced Breast Cancer

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to learn about the safety and efficacy of Dasatinib in combination with Capecitabine for patients with advanced breast cancer, and who have received treatment with a taxane and an anthracycline

Posted outcomes: Number of Participants With Dose Limiting Toxicities Per Dose Level - Safety Population. timeframe=Day 1 to 30 days post last dose. 50 mg Dasatinib + 825 mg/m^2Capecitabine=1; 70 mg Dasatinib + 825 mg/m^2Capecitabine=1; 70 mg Dasatinib + 1000 mg/m^2Capecitabine=1
